title: Trapezoidal integration
prompt: Implement `trapz(y, dx)` — composite trapezoid rule on equally spaced samples with step dx. Return float.
public_tests_hint:
- integrates y=1 → length*dx
- integrates linear ramp accurately
test_source:
import solution

def run():
    y=[1,1,1,1]
    assert abs(solution.trapz(y,0.5)-1.5)<1e-12
    y2=[0,1,2,3]
    assert abs(solution.trapz(y2,1.0)-4.5)<1e-12
